instruction: I am currently using Ubuntu. Could you help me set Firefox as my default web browser?

metadata.explanation: Task variation that sets Firefox as the default web browser. Uses custom getter get_default_web_browser__88e8e17a which checks the x-scheme-handler/http MIME type handler using xdg-mime query. Evaluates that the default web browser includes 'firefox.desktop'.
metadata.verification: The getter queries the default handler for x-scheme-handler/http MIME type using xdg-mime. The metric check_include_exclude verifies that 'firefox.desktop' appears in the result, confirming Firefox is set as the default web browser.

Expected value is semantically correct: 'firefox.desktop' is the correct value returned by xdg-mime when Firefox is the default browser
Data flow is correct: Getter extracts default browser handler -> Metric checks for Firefox identifier -> Verification is complete
Complete coverage: The evaluator fully verifies the single requirement (setting Firefox as default web browser)
